mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tenant_data_store (tenant_id, backend, host, port, database_name, schema_name, tablespace, provision_mode, status) VALUES (#{tenantId}, #{backend}, #{host}, #{port}, #{databaseName}, #{schemaName}, #{tablespace,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{provisionMode}, #{status})
INSERT INTO tenant_data_store_account (tenant_id, account_role, username, password_enc) VALUES (#{tenantId}, #{accountRole}, #{username}, #{passwordEnc})
mapper.select: SELECT backend FROM tenant_data_store WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId}

SELECT tenant_data_store.tenant_id FROM tenant_data_store JOIN tenant ON tenant.id = tenant_data_store.tenant_id WHERE tenant_data_store.backend = #{backend} AND tenant_data_store.status = #{readyStatus} AND tenant.status = 'ACTIVE' ORDER BY tenant_data_store.tenant_id
SELECT account_role, username, password_enc FROM tenant_data_store_account WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId}
mapper.update: UPDATE tenant_data_store SET status = #{status}, updated_at = #{now} WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId}
mapper.select: SELECT tenant_id FROM tenant_data_store WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE tenant_data_store_account SET password_enc = #{passwordEnc} WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND account_role = #{accountRole}
mapper.select: SELECT script_token_epoch FROM tenant_data_store WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId}
mapper.update: UPDATE tenant_data_store SET script_token_epoch = script_token_epoch + 1, updated_at = #{now} WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId}
